messages:
tess_sales: Prospect wants a 4-week POC, strict EU-only data residency (control plane + metrics). They asked for subprocessor list, IP allowlist, and BYOK. Can we do this fast?

mike_presales: Short: yes, but only Dedicated (tenant-pin) or Private. Hosted can't promise control plane residency. We should offer Dedicated EU-only for the POC.

ana_security: We can provide a redacted subprocessor list and SOC2 artifacts. BYOK: Private = customer KMS, Dedicated = tenant-managed keys (onboarding). Need legal signoff for subprocessor addendum.

jon_ops: Ops notes: reserve eu-central-1 capacity, schedule a 30m vuln scan, collect customer KMS ARN if BYOK. Hot-standby in EU OK but extra cost and adds ~1wk prep.

tess_sales: Pricing ask: 4-week Dedicated EU-only + BYOK onboarding. Quick ballpark?

mike_presales: Ballpark: 8k/week + 1.5k/week standby if requested + 4k one-time BYOK. ~36k total w/o standby. I'll confirm with finance.

saml-bot: Ticket created: POC-EU-1990012345 - presales checklist added.
